### Option 1: Bold and Vibrant (Focus on Color and Expression)
> "Alex brings a burst of color to the office every day. Their style is a confident mix of sharp tailoring and playful flair; they often wear a crisp, navy blazer paired with a silk blouse in a bold, geometric print. A pair of oversized, colorful sunglasses and a statement ring on their left hand complete the look. Their hair is styled in a textured, asymmetrical cut that catches the light, and they always carry themselves with an open, welcoming posture that makes everyone feel included."
